text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超3%，沪指跌1.2%，深成指跌2.39%，算力硬件、军工、消费电子、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股近4600只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index and STAR 50 Index both fell more than 3%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 1.2%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.39%, with computing hardware, military, consumer electronics, semiconductors and other directions leading declines, and nearly 4,600 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
